notes: Adamsdown_Boy written as at v9.5.6.2 (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds, in activities rated Normal, Hard and Very Hard difficulty, particularly on Void builds. Reghusk's Pledge is a rapid-fire auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being an outlier amongst auto subfamilies, with a solid damage profile. The frame intrinsic offers a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when starting a reload with an empty mag as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. By comparison with its peers, the stats are good - you can see at https://d2foundry.gg/w/2370525224 how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. The recoil is vertical but loose, so look for a barrel perk that helps you with control or, if you're comfortable look to increase handling. With the mag perk, look for something that improves mag size or reload speed (or both). For Void builds, in the first trait perk column you have the choice of either Destabilizing Rounds to spread Void Volatility on a kill in a 6.5m radius and provide Volatile Rounds for 4.5s (5.25s when enhanced) or Demoralize to spread a ~4m AoE cloud of Void Weaken to nearby enemies for a ×1.15 boost to damage for your fireteam for 3s (5s when enhanced) on a crit kill. Kills on any affected enemy will proc Repulsor Brace's ×0.5 damage resisting Void overshield for 8s (10s enhanced) after killing a void-debuffed enemy - duration boosted by ×1.5 with Echo of Persistence. The only origin trait on offer is Skulking Wolf which, after you get a kill at ≤90 HP, enhances radar and makes adds less accurate when firing at you for 10s. Recommended MW: Stability or Handling with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
